---
name: Documentation issue
about: Report unclear, incorrect, missing, or inconsistent documentation.
title: "[Docs] "
---

## Document and section

Link to the file and heading. Include the revision if it matters.

## Problem and proposed correction

Describe what you expected to learn, what is unclear or incorrect, and the suggested change. For README changes, consider both language versions.

## Evidence or reproduction

For incorrect commands or claims, include the command, prerequisites, observed result, and source that supports the correction. Distinguish historical results from a check you ran yourself.

<!-- Use synthetic examples. Do not attach personal paths, identifiers, credentials, real character snapshots, private screenshots, player saves, or raw game resources. -->
